notes.zh-CN: Claude 切换厂商后立即更新模型并刷新列表，已有对话会自动恢复到新厂商。macOS universal 为开发签名，未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，可在团队已注册设备上安装。
notes.en: Claude provider switches update the displayed model and refresh the model list immediately, and existing conversations reload on the selected provider. macOS universal is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
